notes.title: Bloxpath Launches June 3, 2025 – Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Hello, puzzle lovers!

Get ready to roll—Bloxpath arrives on Steam on June 3, 2025, at 9:01 AM PDT! Inspired by Bloxorz, this minimalist puzzle game lets you roll various special blocks in a 3D space, featuring ~10 unique puzzle mechanics, ~200 challenging puzzles, and satisfyingly smooth procedural animations.

What’s in Bloxpath:
[list]
[*]Simple, intuitive controls for players of all skill levels.
[*]Carefully crafted levels offering hours of brain-teasing fun.
[*]Immersive 3D environments with stunning visuals.
[*]A relaxing yet challenging experience for all ages.
[/list]
 
Wishlist Bloxpath now to stay updated and join the puzzle adventure on launch day! Thank you for your support—we can’t wait to see you master the levels!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3249900/Bloxpath/

notes.title: Version 2.2.1 - Major Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your support! Based on player feedback, I've implemented the following improvements to the demo version:

[h2]New World Map[/h2]
Revamped puzzle unlocking system to a node-based world map structure, providing smoother difficulty progression.

[h2]Puzzle Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added/removed/modified a lot of puzzles
[*]Streamlined unnecessary complexities in specific puzzles
[*]Implemented tutorial-style guiding puzzles
[/list]
*Note: Old saves remain compatible, but new games are recommended for optimal experience

[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added numpad 1-9 quick selection for blocks
[*]Pause menu now displays puzzle progress (lower-left) and coordinates (upper-right)
[*]Fixed configuration settings save issue
[/list]

notes.title: 1-C, Replay Puzzle, 2-B Puzzle Adjustment
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of the game. Based on player feedback, I have made some modifications to the demo version.

[h2]1-C[/h2]
Opened the 1-C area, which includes a playable puzzle.

[h2]Puzzle Replay[/h2]
Added a puzzle replay feature. Stand at the entrance of a completed puzzle and wait for a while to re-enter the puzzle. This feature can be turned off in the settings, and it is currently enabled by default.

[h2]2-B Puzzle Adjustment[/h2]
For the confusing 2-B puzzle, I have added a tutorial level and adjusted the original puzzle. Note: After the update, the original puzzle will be in an unsolved state.
